title: Parallel sum with std::thread
hints: Give each thread its own slice `[i*n/k, (i+1)*n/k)` and its own slot in a `std::vector<long long> partial(k)`: no shared writes, so no race.
Start the threads in a `std::vector<std::thread>` (with `emplace_back` and a lambda), join them all, then add up the partial sums.
